items.title: IMCBench
items.summary: Task: Multi-turn image-grounded medical conversations. Eval Protocol: Clinical images + synthetic patient profiles, judged on safety / accuracy / uncertainty handling; 8 frontier models across 4 families (Claude, GPT, Nova, Llama). Key Finding: Best model (Claude Opus 4.6) scores only 3.61/5; no model excels uniformly, and safety degrades on malignant or rare conditions

items.title: ZPPO: Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization — Teacher in Prompts, Not Gradients
items.summary: Method: Teacher guidance injected via reformulated prompts (correct teacher + incorrect student responses on hard questions), not gradient-level distillation. Key Result: On Qwen3.5 at 4 student scales (0.8B–9B) with a 27B teacher, post-trained as VLMs: outperforms off/on-policy distillation and GRPO across a 31-benchmark suite (16 VLM, 10 LLM, 5 video)

items.title: Kairos
items.summary: Type: "Native world model stack" for Physical AI — unified understanding + generation + prediction. Scale / License: 4B unified architecture; Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention (sliding + dilated windows + gated linear attention). Key Result: Native pre-training via a cross-embodiment data curriculum (open-world video → human behavior → robot interaction); real-time rollout on consumer/edge hardware; beats 14B models on embodied benchmarks

items.summary: Key Contribution: Asymmetric Preservation Principle: geometric content survives video generation, control signals don't. GRA supervises perception with 2D end-effector waypoints from synthetic videos while training actions only on real demos — beating pseudo-action baselines

items.title: DreamX-World 1.0
items.summary: Type: General-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model. Scale / License: 5B (Wan2.2-T2V-5B base); MIT-licensed open weights (HF, GitHub). Key Result: Controllable long-horizon generation with camera navigation, revisits to previously seen regions, and promptable events; E-PRoPE camera-aware positional encoding; causal forcing + DMD distillation turn a bidirectional generator into a few-step autoregressive world model, with long-rollout training suppressing drift

items.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
items.summary: Key Contribution: World models treat the world as a "tracking shot": off-screen entities are frozen and resumed as-left rather than evolving while unseen. The failure persists across architectures and scales — better image quality or more parameters won't fix it; a decoupled internal state is architecturally missing
